jobs.occupation: Professor / Associate Professor / Senior Researcher taking lead in Catchment and Freshwater Ecosystem sciences
jobs.description:
Are you an engaged, leading scientist of international standing, with deep expertise in the research of catchments and freshwater ecosystems, and excellent science leadership skills? Do you have the scientific vision to guide the strategic direction for a nationally and internationally recognized research community working with catchments, wetlands, lakes, streams and nature-based solutions?

The Department of Ecoscience at Aarhus University invites applications for a full-time permanent scientific position (Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Senior Researcher) in the Catchment science and Freshwater Ecology (CaFE) focus area. We are looking for a scientist who enjoys taking lead and working strategically with organizational impact covering the range of research areas in CaFE.

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a permanent position from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible.

Job description

The position centers around research and research based advisory in catchment processes and freshwater ecosystems – including wetlands, streams and lakes and the landscapes like forests, agricultural areas etc. that surround them.  We expect the candidates to have expertise and track record with one or more of the key thematic areas:

• Hydrology and the retention and transport of nutrients and hazardous substances

• Biogeochemical processes and emissions of greenhouse gases from land and water bodies, including interactions with carbon and nutrient dynamics

• Freshwater ecology and the links between abiotic and biotic processes, including ecosystem functioning, biodiversity, and responses to human pressures and climate change

• Nature-based solutions and ecosystem restoration to strengthen biodiversity and resilience and reduce nutrient loss, limit greenhouse gas emissions and regulate water flow in the landscape

• Combining long-term monitoring data with novel research using laboratory, mesocosm and field experiments, in situ sensor data and catchment- and ecosystem modelling

At Department of Ecoscience, all scientific staff in general are expected to contribute to external income generation, dissemination of knowledge, and talent development. Your specific scientific responsibilities may also include:

• Taking the lead on the development and implementation of the CaFE focus area strategy as part of the Department’s strategy, Ecoscience 2030 – including formulating concrete goals and action plans for implementation in dialogue with colleagues and the Department’s management

• Setting the direction and fostering a strong and inclusive research environment across the Section for Catchment Science and Environmental Management, the Section for Freshwater Ecology and the Centre for Nature-based Solutions

• Bringing our research and knowledge to Danish ministries and agencies as well as to other relevant national, European and international decision makers through science-based advice, making an impact for the society around us

• Promoting innovation within the focus area and wider department by fostering use of new and/or novel technologies through closer dialogue and interaction with other sections/focus area within the department and across the faculty

• Supporting the scientific development and career paths of colleagues in the focus area

Your profile

We are looking for a scientist with a strong research track record as well as documented experience with science-based advisory work and leadership of research staff. You have expertise within catchment science and freshwater ecology, previous experience working in interdisciplinary teams and from broad sectoral collaborations. Applicants must hold a PhD in hydrology, limnology, freshwater ecology, biogeochemistry, environmental science, physical geography, environmental engineering or a closely related discipline. The level of appointment (Full Professor, Associate Professor or Senior Researcher) will be determined based on qualifications.

We value in particular:

• Excellent leadership experience from similar research environments; e.g., leading larger research groups and taking responsibility for strategic development of larger units (academic citizenship)

• Skills in strategic scientific coordination, strategy development, project management, and building research networks

• An established international network, collaborative skills and relationships within catchment science and/or freshwater ecology and nature-based solutions

• Documented experience in securing and leading externally funded research projects

• Documented experience with science-based advisory work and engagement with authorities and other stakeholders

Excellent written and spoken English; Strong Danish language skills are an advantage.

Who we are

The Department of Ecoscience, with approximately 300 employees in Aarhus and Roskilde, is one of Denmark's leading research environments in applied ecology, spanning terrestrial, freshwater, marine, and Arctic ecosystems. We conduct both fundamental and applied research and deliver Science-based advisory services to authorities in Denmark and Greenland. Our work is grounded in long-term monitoring, field-based data collection, and advanced modelling, and we pride ourselves on a research culture characterized by high scientific integrity, strong interdisciplinary collaboration, and societal relevance. Our values are impact, professionalism, curiosity, collaboration and trust.

CaFE is the department's focus area for catchment science and freshwater ecology, integrating the Section for Catchment Science and Environmental Management, the Section for Freshwater Ecology and the Centre for Nature-based Solutions. We are around 80 research and technical employees working to generate the data and knowledge that qualify decision-making on conservation and recovery of deteriorated wetlands and inland waters. Our vision is to maintain and expand our position as the key national focal point for applied research and modelling within catchment processes and freshwater ecosystem dynamics, helping authorities monitor, manage and mitigate human impacts on wetlands and freshwaters.

We combine long-term monitoring data with experimental approaches and modelling, and we have the strongest national scientific environment within modelling of nutrient transport, biogeochemical processes in wetlands, experimental freshwater ecology, lake ecosystem modelling and lake restoration. Key infrastructure includes a series of living labs in constructed wetlands, lakes, ponds and streams, including the semi-field mesocosm lake experiments at Lemming that have been running for more than 30 years.

Find out more about our current strategy, departmental values and more here: https://ecos.au.dk/en/about-us/au-ecoscience-our-strategy

What we offer

• A full-time permanent scientific position with an internationally competitive research environment and access to unique long-term datasets and world-class field and semi-field infrastructure

• A central role in shaping the scientific direction of CaFE, contributing actively to the focus area strategy under Ecoscience 2030 and beyond

• An interdisciplinary and dynamic working environment across catchment, freshwater, terrestrial, marine and Arctic research

• Highly engaged, motivated and positive colleagues and an innovative and dynamic working environment, where culture and values are important

• A working environment characterized by high scientific standards, trust, and well-being

• Close, trust-based relationships with Danish ministries and agencies and strong national and international research networks

• Access to professional support for international researchers and their families relocating to Denmark

For candidates with the right qualifications and experience in strategic research leadership, a temporary role as Deputy Head of Department with responsibility for the CaFE focus area of the Department of Ecoscience will be possible. This role includes participation in the Department’s management group. Further education/competence building in leadership will be offered. Contact the Head of Department (details below) for a more detailed description of this role.

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is AU Campus Aarhus, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Department Mikkel Tamstorf (mpt@ecos.au.dk; +45 53 57 50 44).

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

• Has an educational background within Finance, Economics, Organisation or a related field

• Works in a structured and analytical way with an eye for detail

• Understands why high-quality master data matters when making business decisions

• Is an advanced Excel user, while experience with SAP and BI tools is an advantage

• Takes initiative and enjoys working both independently and together with others

• Communicates confidently with colleagues across functions, countries and cultures

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

**We are seeking a Business Controller with strong motivation for the FP&A area for our Group Finance team. You are newly graduated or have 1-3 years of experience and will play a central role in ensuring timely and accurate management reporting, as well as in-depth analyses of our business and financial KPIs. _You will be part of a dynamic team where cross-functional collaboration and close interaction with a wide range of stakeholders are an integral part of everyday work.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

**Join an inclusive community

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

**Send us your application

**Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

jobs.occupation: Lead Portfolio Manager to Support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is a fast-developing company providing regional power system planning data and security analysis to support the national Transmission System Operators of Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark - to ensure the efficient operation of the Nordic Power System and high security of power supply at any time, with a vision of green transition by developing the relevant tools and data.

Right now, we are looking for a Lead Portfolio Manager who likes making a difference and supporting our journey of growth and organizational maturity.

**Job Description

**As a Lead Portfolio Manager, you will join a team of skilled colleagues and contribute to Nordic RCC ambitious goals of green transition together with our owners in the 4 Nordic countries.

The Portfolio team is sitting in the PMO organization, together with Nordic Project Support team and the local project management team. You will report directly to the Head of PMO and have a close collaboration with the other Senior Portfolio Manager, the local project management group and the manager of the Nordic Project Support team as well as the leadership team and Finance.

**Responsibilities

**Your tasks will include:

Portfolio management

• Drive continuous optimization of the Nordic RCC project portfolio with a focus on efficiency and strategic alignment.

• Lead financial budgeting and long-term planning in close collaboration with Finance, Experts, Project Manager and Team Leads to provide estimates for resource allocation both short- and long-term.

• Develop and deliver monthly portfolio reporting, including dependency tracking, to the leadership team and relevant stakeholders to provide an overview of critical deadlines and potential risks.

• Develop and deliver portfolio recommendation for Leadership team and Head of PMO

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Coordination

**

• Foster collaboration between internal and external stakeholders to enhance efficiency and ensure continuous project execution.

• Act as the central point of contact for project-related inquiries from local project managers and teams.

• Maintain a comprehensive overview of project dependencies and support departments in addressing organizational challenges related to products, processes, and resources.

**Governance & Best Practices

**

• Own and maintain the project Stage-Gate model, including governance structures and project management guidance.

• Ensure best practices are documented and prepare evidence for future audits.

• Drive continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies, standardizing processes, and enhancing project governance within the PMO.

**Tools & Processes

**

• Oversee portfolio and resource management processes and tools, ensuring they support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications

**

• Hold a master’s degree in economics, engineering or a related field.

• Are proficient in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.

• Exhibit strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

• Value teamwork and have a collaborative mindset.

• Respectful of agreements, deadlines, other people’s time and ideas, and listening to customer needs.

• Structured in your work and approach to tasks, working in an orderly manner.

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills, preferably combined with programming experience

**Requirements

**

• Have significant experience (more than 5-10 years) as a Project Portfolio Manager within an IT organisation, if possible a combination with knowledge from European renewable energy sector

• You bring a strong financial background and analytical mindset, enabling you to lead long-term planning and budgeting in close collaboration with Finance. Your financial insights make you a trusted advisor to the leadership team.

• You like to prepare and update management reports, presentations and follow up on activities.

• You like to gain and share knowledge/experience of various portfolio methods and processes.

• You have experience with both portfolio management and project management

**Employment conditions

**You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 23 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime.

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

**Application deadline and contact information

**Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

Link to apply: https://www.globesearch.dk/en/jobs/4463b01e-b1c7-4674-b81f-4b2cb44ef5df

Are you an experienced climate and restoration leader ready to shape strategy and turn it into practical results? Do you enjoy developing services, building partnerships and bringing international teams together around shared goals? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What You Can Expect

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Director of Climate and Restoration to lead our Climate and Restoration Programme within the Sustainability Certification division and coordinate climate and restoration work across our Advisory, Certification and Projects divisions.

Reporting to the Sustainability Certification Director, you will combine strategic and technical leadership with programme management, service development and external engagement. Our certification programme currently covers carbon project validation and verification, ecosystem restoration services, and verification of organisational and product carbon footprints. You will help this portfolio evolve in response to climate science, standards, regulation and market needs.

You will also lead our Climate Impact initiative, translating our ambition to build a strong portfolio of mitigation and adaptation services by 2028 into coordinated workplans and measurable progress.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

• Lead the Climate and Restoration Programme, ensuring effective service delivery and progress towards financial and impact targets.

• Shape organisation-wide priorities for climate and restoration, aligning services, projects and expertise across divisions and regions.

• Develop services and delivery approaches that respond to stakeholder needs and create meaningful environmental and social impact.

• Oversee the systems, tools, templates and technical guidance needed for accreditation and credible service delivery.

• Build strategic relationships with clients, companies, NGOs, governments, donors, producers and assurance schemes.

• Identify and pursue business development, partnership and fundraising opportunities.

• Represent Preferred by Nature in conferences, technical networks, industry initiatives and other external forums.

• Lead and develop your team through clear priorities, capacity planning, regular feedback and professional development.

• Contribute to strategic planning, programme budgets, financial monitoring and reporting.

Your first year with us:

Within Three Months, You Will

• Build working relationships with colleagues across Certification, Advisory, Projects and regional teams, alongside key external stakeholders.

• Review the Climate Impact roadmap and identify priorities, dependencies and opportunities for coordinated action.

Within six months, you will:

• Work with relevant teams to advance priority service development, partnership and market engagement opportunities.

• Establish regular programme reviews covering delivery quality, financial performance, impact and team capacity.

• Put development priorities and training plans in place for your team.

Within twelve months, you will:

• Demonstrate progress against the agreed Climate Impact workplan and programme objectives.

• Have advanced priority services or partnerships that strengthen Preferred by Nature’s climate and restoration portfolio.

• Strengthen coordination across divisions, with clear ownership and effective use of technical expertise.

• Provide recommendations for the next planning cycle based on programme results, market developments and lessons learned.

Important that you:

• Have at least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in senior leadership, programme development, stakeholder engagement and climate or restoration services.

• Bring deep knowledge of climate mitigation, carbon markets, ecosystem restoration and related policy, market and regulatory developments.

• Have a proven ability to set strategic direction and lead complex initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.

• Can build alignment and deliver results in an international organisation where colleagues work across different functions and reporting lines.

• Have experience developing strategic partnerships and identifying opportunities that support organisational impact and growth.

• Bring professional credibility in the climate, carbon, restoration or wider sustainability sector, including experience representing an organisation in senior external forums.

• Understand business development and fundraising, and have experience contributing to budgets and financial management.

• Can lead and develop people, support teams through change and encourage collaboration, learning and accountability.

• Combine an entrepreneurial approach with practical judgement and a focus on measurable results.

• Share Preferred by Nature’s commitment to positive environmental and social impact.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

• Have worked across several areas of our current portfolio, such as carbon project validation and verification, ecosystem restoration, and organisational or product carbon footprints.

• Have experience connecting assurance services, advisory work and project delivery within a shared organisational strategy.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

What Sets Us Apart

• Global work culture

• High degree of flexibility – remote work, work from home.

• An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.

• Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development

• Potential future international travel opportunities

• A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment

• Start with 20 days of vacation leave per year

Preferred by Nature

Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission-driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. We develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains, supporting better land management and business practices that benefit people, nature and the climate.

How To Apply

If you feel you meet the requirements of the role, please submit your application, including salary expectations, via the application form below. Application pre-screening will be conducted during the application period.

Preferred by Nature wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Senior Data Engineer - AI & Databricks , you will help shape how AI is adopted across Danfoss Climate Solutions, especially within our global sales organization.

Working as part of a global team of data, analytics, and AI professionals, you will build and evolve a trusted, scalable, and well-governed Databricks platform that enables sales teams across multiple regions and functions to turn data into actionable insights. Your work will support use cases such as sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights, helping teams make faster, data-driven decisions.

By ensuring the platform is secure, high-quality, and continuously improving, you will enable reliable data products and Generative AI solutions that drive business value. Working closely with data engineers, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders, you will help establish best practices and scale AI adoption across the organization.

Success in this role means delivering trusted, AI-ready data products that strengthen governance, accelerate AI adoption, and support better business decisions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own and improve Databricks governance, including Unity Catalog, data access, security, and data quality

• Design and maintain scalable data architecture, ensuring best practices across data models, tables, and pipelines

• Enhance Genie spaces (AI-powered knowledge tools) by improving content, entity matching, and answer quality for end users

• Partner with cross-functional teams to enable adoption of data products and AI solutions that support data-driven sales decisions

• Evaluate and implement new Databricks and AI capabilities to improve platform performance and deliver measurable business value

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Azure Synapse), including Unity Catalog and data governance practices

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands-on experience building scalable data models and modern ETL pipelines

• Proven ability to design and manage data platforms that enable analytics or AI use cases in a business environment

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, translating data and AI capabilities into practical business solutions

• Fluent in English, with strong communication skills and a proactive interest in applying emerging AI technologies

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• Shape how AI is applied across global sales teams, driving measurable improvements in forecasting, pipeline visibility, and customer insights

• Work hands-on with Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Generative AI to build solutions used across multiple markets

• Influence how data and AI solutions are scaled globally, working with diverse teams and stakeholders

• Grow in a collaborative and international environment that supports continuous learning, innovation, and career development

• A competitive compensation package and flexible hybrid working model, with access to global opportunities

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you’re excited about building data platforms that power real-world AI applications and drive business decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and explore how your work can shape the future of AI at Danfoss.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

As a Student Assistant in the Supply Chain team at CRH Denmark, you will have the opportunity to work with data analysis, suppliers, tenders, and contract management. You will become part of an international company where you gain hands-on experience, take ownership of your own tasks, and collaborate with stakeholders across the organization.

The Role

You will support larger sourcing activities and contract management initiatives across CRH Denmark. Through analysis, reporting, and documentation, you will contribute to structured procurement processes, stronger decision-making, and reduced commercial risk.

You will collaborate with functions such as Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, Legal, Finance, Logistics, Operations, and HSEQ. In doing so, you will help translate business needs and category strategies into competitive agreements and measurable value.

Key Responsibilities

• Support sourcing and tender activities, including collecting quotations and comparing supplier solutions.

• Contribute to supplier onboarding, maintenance of supplier data, and follow-up on deliveries and supplier performance.

• Manage contract documentation, procurement data, and other procurement-related records.

• Prepare reports, dashboards, and analyses covering spend, savings, KPIs, and supplier performance.

• Assist with process mapping, improvement initiatives, and the development of templates and frameworks within procurement and supply chain.

Who Are You?

You are analytical and structured, with strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader business context. You are curious about procurement and supply chain management and motivated by turning data into actionable insights.

You take ownership of your responsibilities, work independently, and enjoy collaborating across different functions. We do not expect you to know everything from day one, but we do value a proactive mindset and a willingness to learn.

We Imagine That You:

• Are currently pursuing an HD, Bachelor's, or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Possess strong analytical capabilities and an interest in commercial topics, procurement, and supplier management.

• Have solid Excel skills and an interest in tools such as Power BI, TARGIT, ERP systems, or other data analytics platforms.

• Are proficient in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint and can present data and conclusions in a clear and structured manner.

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing.

Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

• Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality

• Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach

• Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production

• Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

• Are reliable and a team player

Applicants are invited for a double degree PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Biological and Chemical Engineering programme. The position is available from 01 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

The position is part of the MSCA project TagTIC - Target mining for the development of therapeutics against pathogen-induced cancers, ID: 101311627, Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01-01. Project website: tagtic.eu

Note that this is a double degree PhD project within an MSCA Joint Doctorate. Under the currently planned arrangement, the candidate will work for approximately three years at TissueGnostics GmbH in Vienna, Austria, and one year at Aarhus University, Denmark.

Research area and project description:

Microbial infections are increasingly recognized as important contributors to cancer, but identifying the spatial tissue features and molecular signatures associated with infection-driven disease remains challenging. Integrating tissue imaging with spatial transcriptomics and microbiome information offers opportunities to characterize disease-associated patterns and improve biomarker discovery.

Consortium: This PhD postion is part of the interdisciplinary TagTIC consortium, which brings together expertise in microbiology, virology, oncology, immunology, medicinal chemistry, imaging, AI, and bioinformatics, with support from associated partners in biotech, diagnostics, and science communication. Its collaborative structure allows doctoral candidates to work within a network where discovery science, technology development, training, and societal impact are closely connected.

Project DC11: This PhD is part of the TagTIC consortium. It combines machine learning with image analysis to support precision oncology. The aim is to develop AI algorithms that integrate tissue imaging, spatial transcriptomics and microbiome data (multiomics) to identify biomarkers and predict disease progression.

Project description: For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please simply copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.
